title: Jackie F NDE 6485
content: I was diagnosed with stage three rectal cancer in May 2012. I began rigorous chemotherapy and radiation treatment for the entire months of June and July 2012. During this period of time, I lost twenty-two pounds which brought my weight down to eighty-eight pounds. After my last round of chemotherapy in July, I was admitted into the hospital for a high fever, dehydration and colitis. I was in the hospital in isolation for a week while continuing my daily radiation treatment. When I was released, I was told I had to return to the hospital in three days for blood to be drawn. While walking out of the hospital after getting my blood drawn, I passed out and landed square on my face and chin. My husband was with me and he started shouting my name and begging for someone to come and help. He told me later that I stopped breathing completely for a few minutes. During this time, I had no idea of what was happening in the real world. All I felt and knew was a great peace, a calm. I did not know where I was, but I had never felt such peace and calm in my life. Nothing hurt, and all I wanted to do was rest and not leave that place because what I was feeling was like no feeling I had ever felt before and I knew Jesus was there with me because I heard myself saying, 'Jesus, I don't want to leave.' Then I heard my husband, faintly, shouting my name to wake up, and I fought it. I tried to stay where I was with Jesus, but his shouting finally got through to me. At that point, I knew that because someone was shouting my name, I had to 'go back.' My husband was crying and telling me that I had stopped breathing and I had just laid there very still. Back in this reality again, I remained in a peaceful, calm state because of where I had just come from, and I was not afraid.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus was perceived as present; experiencer heard herself say, 'Jesus, I don't want to leave.'

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Returned because she heard her husband shouting her name and felt she had to 'go back.'
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Return was triggered by hearing her husband faintly shouting her name until it 'got through' to her.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Passed out after blood draw while undergoing cancer treatment; husband reported she stopped breathing for a few minutes.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Predominant element described was profound peace/calm and awareness of Jesus' presence; hearing husband faintly from 'real world' preceded return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience centered on profound peace/calm with perceived presence of Jesus, without described OBE, tunnel, light visuals, or environment details; return prompted by faintly hearing husband shouting her name.
